other_operating_expense_net_abs.description: other_operating_expense_net absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

shares_abs.description: shares: diluted weighted-average share count for the target quarter (predict the count directly; drifts slowly with buybacks/issuance).
